events.title: Adult Craft: Air Dry Clay Art

cases.refreshed: Join us for our monthly adult craft program at Tully Community Branch Library. This month, we'll make adorable figurines using air-dry clay and detailed video instructions. All supplies will be provided. Note: This program is for adults aged 18 and up. Please do not bring children with you. If you do, we will request that the children wait outside the room. Please arrive on time. If you arrive more than 15 minutes late, your spot might be given to someone else. If you cannot make it, please cancel your registration or email me as soon as possible so your spot can be given to someone on the waiting lists. Registration required. For adults 18 and up only.

events.title: Vietnamese Storytime & Craft / Kể chuyện và làm thủ công bằng tiếng Việt

cases.refreshed: Thân mời các bé cùng cha mẹ hoặc người chăm sóc bé đến tham dự Giờ Kể Chuyện và làm thủ công bằng tiếng Việt tại Thư Viện Evergreen! Chúng ta sẽ cùng nhau nghe kể chuyện, hát ca và tham gia các hoạt động vui nhộn giúp bé phát triển kỹ năng ngôn ngữ và niềm yêu thích đọc sách từ sớm. Sau phần kể chuyện, các bé sẽ được hướng dẫn làm một món thủ công đơn giản và sáng tạo để mang về nhà! Chương trình phù hợp với trẻ em ở mọi độ tuổi và là dịp tuyệt vời để cả gia đình cùng học hỏi, vui chơi và kết nối. Không cần đăng ký trước. Hãy rủ bạn bè cùng tham gia nhé! Join us for a fun and engaging Vietnamese Storytime and Craft at Evergreen Library! Children and their parents or caregivers will enjoy stories, songs, and playful activities in Vietnamese that help build early language and literacy skills. Following the Storytime, kids will learn to make a simple and creative craft to take home! This program is perfect for children of all ages, a wonderful opportunity for families to learn, play, and grow together. No registration is required. Bring your friends to join us!

cases.refreshed: [Rescheduled from November 1 to November 8] Join us at the Alviso Branch Library where we will host special STEM themed programs on the 1st & 3rd Sundays of each month. For each STEM Sunday, we will feature a fun, hands-on activity to help learners develop their Science, Tech, Engineering, or Math skills and experience. Some of the activities will be done in groups at Alviso branch while others may be kits you can work on at the library or take home! On this day, participants will watch a towering stream of foam reveal the excitement of catalytic chemistry. For more information on these programs, please check website frequently for updates or call at 408-808-3052. Recommended for ages 5-12+ and Up Free. No registration required.

cases.refreshed: Children in grades K-5 will discover the joy of reading while improving their reading skills through practice with Grant on Mondays. Our reading buddy will listen to children and help them build confidence in their ability to read. They will ask questions about the books being read to encourage reading comprehension. Children will enjoy one-on-one interaction with Grant who has been trained to create a positive reading experience for beginning and developing readers. Availability of Reading Buddies is on a first-come, first-served basis.
